## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in the project.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check:release`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Keyboard and touch behavior checked when relevant
- [ ] Screenshots or recording attached for visible changes

## Source and rights

- [ ] Textual or historical claims cite the primary text or reliable scholarship
- [ ] Source material is distinguished from project-created examples
- [ ] New assets include origin and license information
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, private-network addresses, or unrelated files are included
